en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a gently sloping cobbled road lined with multi‑story townhouses and commercial buildings. A horse‑drawn carriage is visible farther down the street. The architecture appears late 19th–early 20th century European. At the top center there is printed caption text indicating the location as Borna in the Leipzig district and naming the street Grimmaerstraße. Shop signage such as "Richard Schürmer" is visible on the corner building.
